notes: t_reporting_mus_attendance: CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(key_date) IN (3) AND SUM(v.passes_scanned) < 300 THEN 0. MySQL DAYOFWEEK 3 = Tuesday (1 = Sunday). Encoded as a day NAME so the rule is independent of the Snowflake WEEK_START session parameter.
t_reporting_mus_attendance: OR key_date = '20220615'. A single hard-coded closed day carried in the legacy CASE alongside the Tuesday test, under the same <300 threshold.
